mapper.select: SELECT FROM delivery_provider_config WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY channel
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO delivery_provider_config (workspace_id, channel, provider, endpoint, from_address, from_name, credential_ref, credential_last4, webhook_token_hash, webhook_secret_ref, enabled, idempotent_submission, created_by_id) VALUES (#{config.workspaceId}, #{config.channel}, #{config.provider}, #{config.endpoint}, #{config.fromAddress}, #{config.fromName}, #{config.credentialRef}, #{config.credentialLast4}, #{config.webhookTokenHash}, #{config.webhookSecretRef}, #{config.enabled}, #{config.idempotentSubmission}, #{config.createdById})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_generation = config_generation + IF( #{credentialRotated} OR NOT (provider <=> VALUES(provider)) OR NOT (endpoint <=> VALUES(endpoint)) OR NOT (from_address <=> VALUES(from_address)) OR NOT (credential_ref <=> VALUES(credential_ref)) OR NOT (enabled <=> VALUES(enabled)) OR NOT (idempotent_submission <=> VALUES(idempotent_submission)), 1, 0), provider = VALUES(provider), endpoint = VALUES(endpoint), from_address = VALUES(from_address), from_name = VALUES(from_name), credential_ref = VALUES(credential_ref), credential_last4 = VALUES(credential_last4), webhook_token_hash = VALUES(webhook_token_hash), webhook_secret_ref = VALUES(webhook_secret_ref), enabled = VALUES(enabled), idempotent_submission = VALUES(idempotent_submission)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM delivery_provider_config WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND channel = #{channel}
